name: age_at_index
definition: Age in years at index (exact DOB)

name: sex
definition: Recorded sex

name: race
definition: Race categories (White/Black/Asian/other/unknown)

name: ethnicity_hispanic
definition: Hispanic ethnicity, with explicit unknown

name: index_year
definition: Calendar year (or quarter) of index

name: prior_observation_days
definition: Days from first recorded YNHHS visit to index (length of health-system engagement). OMOP observation_period is unusable, so derive it from the first visit

name: care_site_campus
definition: Site of the most recent pre-index encounter (YNHH York St/St Raphael, Bridgeport, Greenwich, L+M, community practice). Analogue of claims 'region'

name: index_setting_inpatient
definition: Drug initiated during or at discharge from an inpatient stay vs outpatient (index-day visit type)

name: insurance_type
definition: Primary payer: Medicare / Medicaid / commercial / dual / self-pay

name: low_income_or_dual
definition: Medicaid, dual eligibility or low-income subsidy indicator

name: area_deprivation_index
definition: ADI national percentile / state decile of residence (Neighborhood Atlas). Only the current ZIP is available, so use a ZIP/ZCTA-level approximation

name: area_ses_other
definition: CDC SVI or ZIP median household income (ACS). Khera-lab T2D registry used ZIP income

name: preferred_language_non_english
definition: Preferred language not English / interpreter needed

name: smoking
definition: Current tobacco use (dx proxy); ever-use adds history-of-dependence code
codes: current F17, Z72.0; ever adds Z87.891

name: alcohol_use_disorder
definition: Alcohol abuse/dependence or alcohol-related organ disease

name: drug_use_disorder
definition: Non-alcohol substance use disorder

name: obesity_dx
definition: Obesity diagnosis or BMI-code >= 30

name: bmi
definition: Latest BMI kg/m2

name: heart_failure
definition: Any HF diagnosis

name: prior_hf_hospitalization
definition: Inpatient stay ending before index with I50 (principal or any position); also the count of such stays

name: ischemic_heart_disease
definition: Any IHD (stable/unstable angina, ACS, chronic IHD, old MI)

name: prior_mi
definition: Acute or old MI

name: prior_pci
definition: History of PCI (status code or procedure)

name: prior_cabg
definition: History of CABG

name: atrial_fibrillation_flutter
definition: AF or atrial flutter

name: other_arrhythmia
definition: SVT / other arrhythmia; separately VT/VF or cardiac arrest (any prior)

name: conduction_disorder
definition: AV block / bundle branch block. ECG-proximal: expect the embedding to capture it

name: cardiac_device
definition: PPM / ICD / CRT present or implanted

name: valve_disease
definition: Valvular heart disease

name: prior_valve_procedure
definition: Prosthetic valve / TAVR / surgical valve

name: cardiomyopathy
definition: Cardiomyopathy (dilated, hypertrophic, other)

name: hypertension
definition: Hypertension

name: pulmonary_hypertension
definition: Pulmonary hypertension / pulmonary heart disease

name: hyperlipidemia
definition: Hyperlipidemia

name: ischemic_stroke
definition: Ischemic stroke or sequelae

name: intracranial_hemorrhage
definition: Hemorrhagic stroke / ICH

name: tia
definition: Transient ischemic attack

name: peripheral_arterial_disease
definition: PAD / atherosclerosis of extremities / PAD procedures

name: vte_history
definition: DVT/PE history

name: cha2ds2_vasc
definition: CHA2DS2-VASc (and CHADS2) computed from age, sex, HF, HTN, DM, stroke/TIA/embolism, vascular disease

name: has_bled_modified
definition: Claims-modified HAS-BLED (HTN, renal/liver disease, stroke, bleeding, age>65, antiplatelet/NSAID, alcohol; labile INR from INR variability if on warfarin)

name: diabetes_any
definition: Diabetes mellitus (any type); T1D (E10) as sub-flag

name: t2d
definition: Type 2 diabetes

name: diabetes_complications_dcsi
definition: Diabetes complications: retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy, PVD, metabolic (DKA/HHS); DCSI score

name: hypoglycemia
definition: Hypoglycemia events

name: ckd_any
definition: Chronic kidney disease

name: eskd_dialysis_transplant
definition: ESKD, chronic dialysis or kidney transplant

name: acute_kidney_injury
definition: AKI

name: hyperkalemia
definition: Hyperkalemia diagnosis

name: fluid_electrolyte_disorder
definition: Fluid/electrolyte/acid-base disorders (Elixhauser)

name: thyroid_disease
definition: Hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism

name: obstructive_sleep_apnea
definition: OSA

name: copd
definition: COPD / emphysema / chronic bronchitis

name: asthma
definition: Asthma

name: pneumonia_recent
definition: Pneumonia (acute illness marker)

name: liver_disease
definition: Chronic liver disease incl. cirrhosis (Charlson mild/severe)

name: gi_bleed
definition: GI hemorrhage / bleeding peptic ulcer; peptic ulcer disease (Charlson) as a sub-flag

name: major_bleed_other
definition: Other major bleeding: hemorrhage NOS, hematuria, acute posthemorrhagic anemia, hemoptysis, hemarthrosis

name: anemia
definition: Anemia diagnosis

name: coagulopathy_thrombocytopenia
definition: Coagulation defects / thrombocytopenia (Elixhauser)

name: dementia
definition: Dementia / Alzheimer disease

name: depression
definition: Depressive disorder

name: anxiety
definition: Anxiety disorders

name: serious_mental_illness
definition: Psychosis / schizophrenia / bipolar

name: falls
definition: Falls

name: gait_mobility_weakness
definition: Gait abnormality, weakness, debility

name: malnutrition_weight_loss
definition: Malnutrition / abnormal weight loss / cachexia

name: osteoporosis_fracture
definition: Osteoporosis or fragility fracture

name: cancer_any
definition: Any malignancy excluding non-melanoma skin

name: metastatic_cancer
definition: Metastatic solid tumor (Charlson)

name: rheumatologic_disease
definition: Connective tissue / inflammatory arthritis (Charlson)

name: charlson_index
definition: Charlson comorbidity index (Quan ICD-10 coding, 17 conditions)

name: elixhauser_index
definition: Elixhauser comorbidities (AHRQ refined, 31-38 categories) or van Walraven score

name: combined_comorbidity_score
definition: Gagne combined Charlson-Elixhauser score (standard in RCT-DUPLICATE and Sentinel)

name: claims_frailty_index_kim
definition: Kim claims-based frailty index (93 items: 52 ICD, 25 CPT, 16 HCPCS). Segal indicator as an alternative

name: hospital_frailty_risk_score
definition: Gilbert Hospital Frailty Risk Score (109 ICD-10 codes). OHDSI FeatureExtraction analysis 926

name: cardiovascular_risk_equation
definition: PREVENT / PCE / PCP-HF 10-y risk from age, sex, SBP, BP treatment, DM, smoking, lipids, eGFR, BMI

codes: captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, ramipril, benazepril, fosinopril, quinapril, perindopril, trandolapril, moexipril + brands

name: arb
definition: Any order of ARB in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)
codes: losartan, valsartan, candesartan, irbesartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, eprosartan, azilsartan

name: arni
definition: Any order of ARNI in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: beta_blocker

codes: carvedilol, metoprolol, bisoprolol, atenolol, nebivolol, propranolol, labetalol, nadolol

name: mra
definition: Any order of MRA in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: loop_diuretic

name: ccb_nondhp

name: nitrate
definition: Any order of nitrate in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: digoxin

name: statin

name: nonstatin_lipid

name: aspirin
definition: Any order of aspirin in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: p2y12
definition: Any order of P2Y12 inhibitor in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

definition: Any order of oral anticoagulant in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: sglt2i
definition: Any order of SGLT2 inhibitor in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: insulin
definition: Any order of insulin in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: nsaid
definition: Any order of NSAID in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)
codes: ibuprofen, naproxen, meloxicam, diclofenac, celecoxib, ketorolac, indomethacin

name: ppi
definition: Any order of proton-pump inhibitor in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: oral_corticosteroid
definition: Any order of systemic corticosteroid in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)

name: opioid
definition: Any order of opioid in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)
codes: oxycodone, hydrocodone, morphine, tramadol, hydromorphone, fentanyl, methadone

name: antidepressant
definition: Any order of antidepressant in window (drug_exposure token match (first word of order), orders only)
codes: sertraline, citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine, venlafaxine, duloxetine, bupropion, mirtazapine, trazodone
